headline: No one appeared for a public hearing on the sale of Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business Park.
summary: A public hearing was held on the sale of Lot #6 of the Southeast Bristol Business Park. No one appeared to speak, and the hearing was closed.
plain_text:
